name: Retributive Curses
description:
A creature becomes a target for retribution when it transgresses against you in one of the following ways:

  • Harm. The creature attacks or deals damage to you, your familiar, or a creature holding a Token or Talisman you created.

  • Threat. The creature forces you to make an opposed skill check against them.

  • Betrayal. The creature intentionally breaks a promise to you.

As a Reaction when a creature within medium range commits such a transgression, you can place one of the following curses on it:

Bloodguilt. The first time on a turn that the creature deals damage to another creature, it takes 1d6+BODY damage and checks a Condition.

Leaden Shoes. The creature's speed is reduced to 5 ft and it can’t make opportunity attacks.

Uncanny Jinx. The creature takes -1d to all skill checks.

Vengeful Gleam. The target glows with a green witch-light. It can’t benefit from magical effects that obscure it, alter its appearance or make it invisible, and attacks against it are favored if the attacker can see it.

The curse lasts for 1 minute. It ends early if the cursed creature dies, you apply a different Retributive Curse to the creature, or you choose to end the curse as an action. You can use this feature HEART times per rest.

improvements.name: Improved Retribution
improvements.description:
Your curses now last for up to 10 minutes. You also gain additional curse options:

Shared Suffering. Each time the creature makes an attack against another creature, it takes 1d8+HEART damage.

Enervation. The creatures takes -1d to all damage rolls.

Muzzle. The target can’t make melee attacks that require use of its mouth(s).

improvements.name: Greater Retribution
improvements.description:
Your curses now last for up to 1 hour. You also gain the following additional curse option:

Humbling Hex. Roll Spirit vs Spirit against the creature. On a win, you transform it into a creature of your choice with a Challenge of 0 that can survive in its current environment. No effect on a loss.
✨: The curse lasts an additional hour.
🌞: The curse lasts for 1 day.
💀: You are transformed instead.
